summary: Only BTCUSD and ETHUSD are in the briefing (weekend, other markets closed). Both are oversold (RSI 31 and 27) after a weak 20-hour trend, but similar past bars were higher 24 hours later in 47% and 49% of cases, which is no better than the all-bar base rate. Samples are large (n above 2500), so the figures are used as measured, and they give no tradable edge.

evidence.claim: Similar past hourly bars (same 24h trend and RSI bucket): up 47% of n=2518 after 24 trading hours (all bars: 47%).
Similar past hourly bars (same 24h trend and RSI bucket): up 49% of n=2536 after 24 trading hours (all bars: 46%).
